description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View extension to track width changes using PreferenceKey, along with a testing utility within a debug compilation block.

classes.name: ViewWidthPreferenceKey
classes.description: A PreferenceKey that captures the maximum width value from view preferences.

classes.name: ViewMetricsTesting
classes.description: A utility enum containing a method to reduce width values during testing (only in debug mode).

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: A View extension method that adds a background GeometryReader to track and notify about width changes.

methods.name: reduceWidth
methods.description: A static method used during testing to determine the reduced width value among a current and next value.
